quotes.title: Will the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, for November 20, 2026 be above $0.80?
quotes.rules_primary: If the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, as reported in the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report scheduled for publication on November 20, 2026 is above $0.80, then the market resolves to Yes.
quotes.rules_secondary: This market uses advertised retail prices, not transaction prices. The relevant value is the “This Week” Wtd Avg Price for the row with Commodity “Avocados,” Variety “Hass,” and Unit “each” in the National Conventional Summary section of the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report. Prices for other avocado varieties, sizes, package counts, organic avocados, regional tables, “Last Week,” or “Last Year” do not count.

quotes.title: Will the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U in December 2027 be above 1.5%?
quotes.rules_primary: If the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted, in December 2027 is above 1.5%, then the market resolves to Yes.
quotes.rules_secondary: The initially reported value for December 2027 will be used. This market concerns the 12-month percentage change for December 2027, not the annual-average percentage change for the specified year.
